title: Craftable  Extrapolator
description: This is a pallaium addon that makes a recipe for multiversal extrapolator
body:
# What this mod does:  
This mod adds a recipe into a palladium item the \*\*Multiversal Extrapolator\*\*

# Why did I make this mod?:  
I know that palladim has structures for the _Multiversal Extrapolator_ but this mod will make the experience much easier than before

# What is a multiversal extrapolator
Multiversal extrapolater is a palladium item that can be used in the multiversal iterator. Basically it lets players use different variations of items (say a MCU Stormbreaker or a comic accurate version) IF the mod developer gave them variations.
